hypotheses.text: Review S1-007 (should-fix 2, notes 4 and 7): the mapper widens or shortens what the source says in three places. A location condition other than a timezone requirement or context (e.g. kind license, effect require, areas US-UT) leaves a known list passing; a verified worldwide reading with regions or listed countries is still worldwide; Retry-After above 24 h is cut to 24 h. Fix: any such condition withholds the listed countries like an unresolved note and is kept as evidence; worldwide also needs no region and no country list; Retry-After is honoured in full (at least 1 s). Testable: the unit table gains a license-require case (GEO-01 unknown for US), a worldwide+region case (unspecified) and a 30-day Retry-After (stored as given); the 50-job sample's 25/24/1 split does not change because geography never moves a posting between catalog tiers.
